row:
Hello, I'm Steven, a Jing Method™ clinical massage therapist specialising in chronic musculoskeletal pain. I'm based in North London, UK. 

The Jing Method™ is a holistic treatment which works in harmony with the nervous system. 

The aim of the Jing Method™ to relieve pain and release restrictions. The method incorporates hot stones, myofascial release, trigger point therapy, acupressure, stretching and personalised self-care.

As and when I get organised, I'll post some videos of the techniques involved. I also hope to add some self-care videos to help relieve chronic pain issues such as low-back pain, frozen shoulder and plantar fasciitis.
